answer_1.quote: Our approach generates travel itineraries with enhanced spatio-temporal granularity, producing a comprehensive and contextually coherent sequence of Points of Interest (PoIs) that provides a holistic representation of the journey.

answer_2.quote: To systematically assess these aspects, we propose five novel evaluation metrics: Temporal Meal Score, ensuring natural meal scheduling; Temporal Attraction Score, evaluating visit durations; Spatial Score, measuring travel efficiency; Ordering Score, assessing logical sequencing; and Persona Score, capturing alignment with user preferences.
